create_EmaHook: create an EmaHook instance to maintain exponential moving average of model parameters during training
update_ema_weights: update EMA model weights by calling on_update at specified iteration intervals with warmup support
compute_ema_meters: compute and update EMA meters on model outputs and targets during training steps
sync_ema_meter_states: sync EMA meter states across distributed training processes at phase end
save_ema_metrics: save EMA metric logs on the primary node at the end of each training phase
